blocks.title: How to read this report
blocks.intro: This is not a test with right or wrong answers. It shows what your answers say about you and what that could mean for your future. Treat it as advice, not a rule: nothing here is set in stone, and no single career or field is the only right choice. One field of study can lead to many different careers.

items.title: Investment Banker
items.summary: This path aligns well with your high Enterprising, Conventional, and Investigative interests, paired with your Strategic, Execution, Communication, and Leadership strengths. You also showed high interest in values such as Wealth, Status, Reputation, and Impact, which are often found in this field, and you prefer a fast-paced environment in a large organization.
items.market: This career generally offers clear paths for advancement, increasing responsibility, and specialization within different financial areas.
items.takesLabel: WHAT IT TAKES TO GET THERE
items.takes: To enter this field, you would need to gain specific knowledge in finance, learn financial modeling, and acquire practical experience in the banking sector.
items.now: 1. Taking a free online course on basic finance or financial accounting is recommended. — This builds a foundational understanding of how financial markets and businesses operate. 2. Seeking an internship or short training placement in a financial institution is advised. — This provides valuable practical experience and helps you understand the daily work in this sector. 3. Connecting with professionals in investment banking on professional networking sites would be helpful. — This allows you to learn about career paths and gain insights into the industry.
items.aiTitle: How AI may change this career
tasks: Automated data collection and basic financial modeling
Generating initial drafts of market research reports
evidence: Global evidence: General industry trends show that generative AI is increasingly used to automate data analysis, financial forecasting, and report generation in finance, freeing professionals to focus on higher- level tasks. This includes automating parts of merger and acquisition analysis and risk assessment.

In your market: This is a general outlook, not verified job-market data: in the GCC, financial institutions are slowly adopting AI tools, particularly for data processing and risk management, but human relationships and local market expertise remain highly valued.
skills: Complex client relationship management
Strategic deal negotiation and structuring
Ethical judgment in high-stakes transactions
In-depth market insight and foresight
items.means: As a recent graduate, some entry-level data processing tasks may be handled by AI. It would be helpful to understand how AI tools are used for financial analysis and focus on developing strong analytical interpretation skills, alongside your communication and relationship-building strengths, to offer strategic value to clients.

items.title: Lawyer
items.summary: Your strong Investigative, Enterprising, and Conventional interests, combined with your Strategic, Communication, and Learning strengths, fit well with a legal career. You value Reputation, Status, and Impact, which are key aspects of this profession, and you prefer a fast-paced environment in a large organization, such as a law firm or a government legal department.
items.market: The legal field offers many paths for growth, including specialization in areas like tech law, and opportunities to rise to leadership roles within firms or public bodies.
items.takesLabel: WHAT IT TAKES TO GET THERE
items.takes: Becoming a lawyer typically requires completing a law degree and passing the bar examination in the country where you intend to practice.
items.now: 1. Investigating the specific educational and licensing requirements to practice law in Saudi Arabia is a recommended first step. — Understanding these requirements is essential to plan your academic journey effectively. 2. Attending free online webinars or introductory sessions on different areas of law, such as commercial law or intellectual property, would be helpful. — This helps you explore various legal specializations and find areas that genuinely interest you. 3. You could consider volunteering at a local legal aid clinic or a pro-bono initiative. — This offers early exposure to legal practice and helps you develop practical skills in a real-world setting.
items.aiTitle: How AI may change this career
tasks: Automated legal research and document review
Drafting standard contracts and legal summaries
Predicting basic litigation outcomes based on historical data
evidence: Global evidence: General industry trends show that legal technology, including AI, is increasingly used for tasks like e-discovery, contract analysis, and legal research, which can improve efficiency. However, the core functions of legal strategy and client representation remain human-led.

In your market: This is a general outlook, not verified job-market data: while the adoption of legal tech is growing in the GCC, especially for corporate law and compliance, the legal profession continues to value deep legal knowledge, personal judgment, and client trust.
skills: Complex legal argumentation and courtroom advocacy
Providing nuanced legal advice and client counseling
Ethical reasoning and judgment in novel cases
Strategic negotiation and dispute resolution
items.means: For a recent law graduate, AI could significantly change how legal research and document review are performed. It would be beneficial for you to understand how these tools work, allowing you to focus on refining your critical legal analysis, communication, and client advisory skills, which are essential for making complex arguments and building client relationships.

blocks.t: One small step for this week, then a simple 90-day path, built around your top career match
Built around your top match: Investment Banker
Your first step this week

A good first step is to identify three entry-level job or internship postings for careers like Investment Banker, Real Estate Agent, or Lawyer in Saudi Arabia or other GCC countries. You could use professional networking sites or company career pages. Why: This helps you understand the specific skills, qualifications, and experiences that employers are looking for right now in roles that match your interests.
YOU WILL PRODUCE
A short list of three job or internship postings with their key requirements.
WHEN
Within 2 days, about 60 minutes
Worksheet:
Days 2–7

Days 2-3 — We suggest you compare the requirements from your list of job postings with your own academic background and any projects you have completed. Note where your skills align and where there might be gaps. You will produce: A comparison table showing your skills against the job requirements, highlighting matches and differences.

Day 4 — You could consider drafting a basic CV, or resume, tailored to one of the job or internship types you found. Focus on clearly listing your education, any relevant projects, and any volunteer or part-time experience. You will produce: A first draft of a basic CV or resume, no longer than one page.

Days 5-6 — It would help to write a brief cover letter template that introduces you and explains your interest in a role like an Investment Banker or Real Estate Agent. You can refer to your draft CV and the skills you identified in the job postings. You will produce: A short cover letter template (about half a page) that can be adapted for different applications.

Day 7 — A good way to end the week is to review what you produced and pick the next step that feels most useful for you right now. You will produce: A brief note outlining your chosen next step based on your week's work.
Your next 90 days

Weeks 2–4 — Build momentum We advise you to look for a short training placement or internship related to one of the matched careers, such as an internship at a financial institution for an Investment Banker role, or with a real estate agency for a Real Estate Agent role. This is a practical way to gain experience.
You could seek feedback on your draft CV and cover letter from a university career services advisor or a trusted mentor. Their advice can help you improve your application materials.

It would be helpful to identify a free online course that introduces you to the basic terms and concepts of a field like finance or legal work, aligning with careers such as Investment Banker or Lawyer. This can help you understand the sector better.

Months 2–3 — Build You could consider actively applying for 3-5 entry-level internships or trainee positions in sectors that interest you, such as finance or real estate, to gain hands-on experience and build your professional network.

It is recommended to attend relevant online workshops or webinars that focus on interview skills or professional communication. This can help you prepare for job interviews for roles like a Career Counselor or Military Officer.

You might explore gaining a professional certification that is recognized in the GCC for a role like Personal Trainer or Life Coach, if those areas strongly appeal to you. This would involve checking the requirements for local certification bodies.
Your skills to build and practice exercise: Investment Banker
SKILLS TO BUILD

Critical interpretation of AI-generated financial analysis — AI tools can quickly process vast amounts of financial data and generate reports; understanding how to critically evaluate and refine these outputs is important to provide accurate advice.

Ethical decision-making in complex financial situations — While AI can offer data-driven recommendations, the responsibility for ethical choices and navigating complex human situations will remain with you.
PRACTICE EXERCISE

A good exercise would be to find a publicly available basic financial report for a company (for example, a simple income statement or balance sheet). You could then ask a free online AI tool to summarize the key financial trends or potential risks for an investor. After receiving the AI's response, carefully review it. Identify any areas where the AI might have missed nuance, oversimplified, or made assumptions. Then, write a short paragraph explaining what the AI did well and what you would add or change based on your own critical thinking, considering any ethical implications that might arise from its suggestions.
YOU WILL HAVE

You will have the original financial report, the AI's summary or analysis, and your written evaluation noting strengths, weaknesses, and your proposed additions or changes, including any ethical considerations.

intro: Short qualifications employers recognise, chosen to fit your matched careers. These are for later, and certifications change, so check the provider's current list before you enrol.

items.title: Foundations of Financial Modeling
items.about: What it is about: This course teaches how to build financial spreadsheets to predict company performance and value. At the end, you can create basic financial models.
items.why: Why it is suggested: This helps an aspiring investment banker understand company finances and develop a core skill for financial analysis and valuation.

items.title: Certificate in Introduction to Islamic Finance
items.about: What it is about: This covers the basic rules and principles of finance that follow Islamic law. You learn how financial products are structured in an ethical way.
items.why: Why it is suggested: Understanding Islamic finance is very valuable in the GCC, helping you work with institutions that follow these principles and broadening your career options in the region.

items.title: Introduction to Sports Coaching
items.about: What it is about: This course teaches the basics of how to plan training, motivate athletes, and ensure safety in sports. You learn foundational coaching methods.
items.why: Why it is suggested: It gives you the core knowledge and tools to guide individuals or teams in various sports settings, building on your leadership and communication skills.

items.title: Real Estate Fundamentals Course
items.about: What it is about: This teaches the basic laws, ethical practices, and sales methods in buying and selling properties. You gain an understanding of the real estate market.
items.why: Why it is suggested: It provides the essential knowledge needed to understand the real estate market and begin a career in property sales, using your relationship skills.

items.title: Foundations of Legal Research
items.about: What it is about: This teaches you how to find and understand legal information, laws, and court decisions. You learn to effectively gather legal evidence and references.
items.why: Why it is suggested: Strong research skills are very important in legal work, helping you support legal teams and understand legal documents, building on your analytical abilities.

items.title: Certified Life Coach Program
items.about: What it is about: This program teaches you how to guide people to set and achieve their personal and professional goals. You gain the skills to help others grow and make positive changes.
items.why: Why it is suggested: It gives you the structured methods and recognized skills to help individuals improve their lives, directly using your strengths in relationships and communication.

intro: Courses that build the skills your matched careers need. These are for later: use them as a guide when you are ready, not something to do all at once.

items.title: Financial Markets
items.about: What it is about: This course gives an overview of finance, risk management, and investment fundamentals.
items.why: Understanding financial markets is a solid first step for anyone considering a career in investment banking, giving you a base understanding of how money moves.

items.title: Islamic Finance and Banking
items.about: What it is about: This course covers the fundamentals of Shariah-compliant banking and Islamic financial instruments.
items.why: Knowing about Islamic finance is very helpful for an investment banker working in Saudi Arabia, where Shariah-compliant financial practices are important every day.

items.title: Emotional Intelligence
items.about: What it is about: This course helps you develop self-awareness, empathy, and relationship management skills.
items.why: As a sports coach, understanding emotions in yourself and your athletes is key to motivating them and building strong team relationships.

items.title: Real Estate Finance and Investment
items.about: What it is about: This course covers valuation, financing, and investment analysis for real estate.
items.why: Having a good grasp of real estate finance and how properties are valued can help a real estate agent advise clients better and understand the market.

items.title: Contract Law
items.about: What it is about: This course teaches the core principles of contract formation, enforcement, and breach.
items.why: A strong understanding of contract law is a foundational skill for a lawyer, as contracts are a big part of many legal situations.

items.title: Negotiation Mastery
items.about: What it is about: This course offers practical negotiation and conflict resolution frameworks.
items.why: Lawyers often negotiate on behalf of their clients, so developing strong negotiation skills would be very useful for day-to-day legal work.

items.title: Mental Health First Aid
items.about: What it is about: This course helps you recognize and respond to mental health challenges in the workplace.
items.why: A life coach often works closely with people's personal challenges, so knowing how to recognize and respond to mental health concerns in a supportive way is important.

items.title: Learning How to Learn
items.about: What it is about: This course teaches science-backed techniques to study faster and retain more.
items.why: As a life coach, you help people reach their goals, and understanding effective learning and productivity techniques can help you guide your clients better.
